aero_propeller_addon.ponder.integrated_g: Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing
Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing a compact propeller bearing
Its behavior just like the Gyroscopic Propeller Bearing in aeronautics
Compared to aeronautics's Gyroscopic Propeller Bearing, which need assemble with heavy propeller contraption
It assemble various propeller blades items to produce thrust
Compare to Integrated Ordinary Bearing can assemble 6 blades
Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing can assemble 12 blades!double to Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing
More Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing's additional explanation
you maybe notice that integrated Gyroscopic Bearing is TWO block hight
That because it had many extremely powerful mode and function
TRUST ME,IT WILL WORTH IT
Just like Integrated Ordinary Bearing,it can change trust by use a wrench on the top
About blade assemble,stress impact,like Integrated Ordinary Bearing,you can refer ponder about Integrated Ordinary Bearing to know more
How to use Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing
A very simple aircraft,let we start introduce Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing with it
This mode allow you to control bearing by input signal,and in sable mode if no input
You maybe notive that something different at the bottom of bearing
This is redstone signal frequency config panel at four_side of bearing
When one direction recive signal,bearing will contral blade tilt to that direction
Now bearing will control blade start tilt,and push sublevel to move
You can also input signal to side directly
The power of redstone signal will also change blade tilt degree,stronger signal,higher blade tilt degree
When bearing don't recive any signal,stable will working to stable sublevel
Manul Gyroscope mode:without stable mode of gyroscope mode
It aim to let you to get full control of bearing,recive ontime control feedback
At the bottom of Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing's four_side,have a mode switch panel
Altough bearing don't have input ,sublevel will keep moving
It is useful to some situation which need extremly control feedback
Normal mode:just like Gyroscopic Propeller Bearing in aeronautics
When sublevel tilt,bearing will try to keep blade upright
Stable mode:bearing will try tilt blade to reduce sublevel shaking and moving up right to bearing
Ops,sudden force out of ship let ship move toward!
At this time,sable mode will start working
You can see the tilt_animation of blade to judge bearing is working or not
Gyroscope mode:the most important mode to this bearing
The placement of Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing
Integrated Gyroscopic Bearing only allow up and down placement

If want to assemble different types of blade,you CAN ONLY take out all assembled blade

You need to right_click with empty_hand to take out blade

Integrated Ordinary Bearing
Integrated Ordinary Bearing a compact propeller bearing
Its behavior just like the propeller bearings in aeronautics
Compared to aeronautics's propeller bearings, which need assemble with heavy propeller contraption
It assemble various propeller blades items to produce thrust
And compared to aeronautics's andesite propeller, it can produce massive trust with single block
How to use integrated_propeller_bearing
Want propeller to produce thrust, just apply rotational force to it's base
Just like aeronautics's propeller bearing, you can use a wrench to reverse trust without change rotational force direction
You can see thrust change by how particles move
Of course, reverse rotational force directly is also work
